_comment: Sample policy configuration for manual import / reference. All policies are disabled by default.

policies.name: Stale Files (>7 years)
policies.description: Flag files not modified in over 7 years.

policies.name: Risky Executable Types
policies.description: Flag executable and script files that may pose a security risk.

policies.name: Personal Archives
policies.description: Flag compressed archives that may contain personal or unauthorised data.

policies.name: Oversized Files (>5 GB)
policies.description: Flag individual files larger than 5 GB.

policies.name: Temp / Copy Name Pattern
policies.description: Flag files whose names suggest they are temporary copies.

policies.name: Long Path (>240 chars)
policies.description: Flag files whose full path exceeds 240 characters.

policies.name: Unknown Owner
policies.description: Flag files where the owner SID could not be resolved to a domain account.
